# Style menu (generated by `python scripts/styles.py build` - edit the sources, not this file)

Pick by number or name, or say "show me <family> styles". Agents offer the top 3 from `styles.py offer` when a request has no style.
A style is a starting point. Precedence still holds: ledger > brand file > Klaus's brief > style > model defaults.
Script styles borrow STRUCTURE only: never a creator's catchphrases, voice clone or implied endorsement.

## Creator StyleCards

Specific creators (Hormozi, Night Owl Cinematics, Jun Yuh...): `/style <creator>` reads the Supabase StyleCard; `editor.py preset from-stylecard <name>` turns it into a `style-<creator>` edit preset. `styles.py show <creator>` gives the script + edit pairing.
